items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee does not speak about 'Her husband' directly; the mention is made by the interviewer in the context of discussing a third party's personal life.

ctx.x: And they travel a lot. Like in her last letter last week, she told me they are having their next convention in Miami, Florida, and they will come to New York to look at some clothes, and they may pass here, in Los Angeles, and naturally, when they do they will call.
Her husband has his office in his home.
